# Curcumin & Brain Health: Boost Memory and Mood in Just 1 Hour  
13 January 2026  
Written by LEHVOSS Nutrition  
Research demonstrates that [Longvida® Optimized Curcumin®](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_PPS_Jan2026.pdf) delivers **rapid cognitive benefits, with a single 400mg dose** improving attention and working memory [within one hour](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_Mood%20Study_Jan2026.pdf) in healthy older adults¹. Backed by **11+ human clinical studies**, Longvida® is widely recognised as the “[Cognitive Curcumin of Choice™](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_CogCurOfChoice_Jan2026.pdf)”.  
[Research](/news/lehvoss-news/725-new-clinical-trial-reconfirms-longvida-benefits-on-mood-and-memory.html) shows that Longvida® consistently enhances working memory and helps reduce fatigue and stress reactivity2, reinforcing its role in mood and cognitive support.  
These findings which are validated through**double-blind, placebo-controlled studies,**position Longvida® as a clinically backed, bioavailable curcumin option for formulations targeting brain health and healthy aging.
Beyond its cognitive benefits, [research](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_SummaryStudy_Jan2026.pdf) shows that Longvida® provides broad support for overall health, including **reducing inflammation** and **muscle damage3** biomarkers, promoting **cardiovascular4** and **antioxidant5** health, supporting **joints6**, **metabolic health7**, and even the [gut microbiome](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_MicrobiomeStudy_Jan2026.pdf). These multiple benefits make Longvida® ideal for diverse health applications, with just 400mg. Download a summary of the supporting research [here](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_SummaryStudy_Jan2026.pdf).  
Additionally, Verdure Sciences® has earned the **UEBT–Rainforest Alliance certification** for its [Sustainable](/news/lehvoss-news/1180-longvida-optimized-curcumin-a-sustainable-journey.html) Turmeric Program, **empowering 310 farmers** across 640 acres while ensuring **ethical sourcing, full traceability,** and reliable **global supply.** Combined with Longvida®’s robust clinical portfolio (**67+ publications**) and proven cognitive benefits **within one hour of a 400mg dose,** this positions the ingredient as a scientifically validated, sustainably sourced option for brain health formulations.  
**Want to learn more about Longvida®?** For more information, down our Longvida® Product Profile Sheet [here](/images/news/15th_January_2026/Longvida_PPS_Jan2026.pdf) or [contact us](/contact-us/lehvoss-nutrition-team.html).
